'''Nolan Traoré''' (born 28 May 2006) is a French professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Brooklyn Nets]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). He was selected by the Nets with the 19th overall pick in the [[2025 NBA draft]].

==Early life==
Traoré was born on 28 May 2006 and grew up in the [[Communes of France|French commune]] [[Chennevières-sur-Marne]] in the southern suburbs of Paris.<ref name="auto4">{{Cite web|url=https://www.proballers.com/basketball/player/249147/nolan-traore|website=Proballers.com|title=Nolan Traore}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://play.fiba3x3.com/players/74e94330-19f1-4ae4-a93c-2d9059166c9c|publisher=[[FIBA]] 3×3|title=Nolan TRAORÉ}}</ref> He is the younger brother of basketball player [[Armel Traoré]].<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Basket/Actualites/Nolan-traore-17-ans-pigiste-medical-a-saint-quentin-en-betclic-elite/1457318|newspaper=[[L'Équipe]]|language=French|title=Nolan Traoré (17 ans) pigiste médical à Saint-Quentin en Betclic Élite|trans-title=Nolan Traoré (17 years old) medical freelancer in Saint-Quentin in Betclic Élite|date=28 March 2024}}</ref> He began playing basketball at age four with the club COC Chennevières, and played with them from 2010 to 2014.<ref name="auto">{{Cite news|url=https://www.leparisien.fr/sports/basket/promis-a-la-nba-et-la-tete-bien-faite-nolan-traore-la-nouvelle-pepite-du-basket-francais-26-01-2024-QCEIZERIBVD5XDOUDMQEVIMMNY.php|newspaper=[[Le Parisien]]|language=French|trans-title=Promised to the NBA and with a good head: Nolan Traoré, the new nugget of French basketball|title=Promis à la NBA et la tête bien faite: Nolan Traoré, la nouvelle pépite du basket français|author=Lesage, Julien|date=26 January 2024|url-access=subscription}}</ref> He then spent three years with {{ill|VGA Saint-Maur Omnisports|fr}}, being a member of the U9, U10, and U11 teams there.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://vga-basket.com/?page_id=1941|publisher={{ill|VGA Saint-Maur Omnisports|fr}}|title=Félicitations à Nolan TRAORE|trans-title=Congratulations to Nolan TRAORE|language=French|date=2024}}</ref>

Traoré joined the club {{ill|Saint-Charles Charenton|fr|Saint-Charles Charenton Saint-Maurice Basket-ball}} in 2017.<ref name="auto1">{{Cite web|url=https://www.facebook.com/polesespoirsidf/photos/a.767007323422396/2405688999554212/?type=3&_rdr|website=[[Facebook]]|title=Nolan TRAORE (1ère année au Pôle) passé par le COC Basket, la VGA basket et évoluant actuellement à la Saint Charles Basketball.|language=French|trans-title=Nolan TRAORE (1st year at the Pole) passed through COC Basket, VGA basketball and currently playing at Saint Charles Basketball.|publisher=Pôle Espoirs Île-de-France|date=15 November 2019}}</ref> While at Saint-Charles Charenton, he also played for the Pôle Espoirs Île-de-France from 2019 to 2021; he played at the French junior championships in 2020–21 and averaged over 16 points per game.<ref name="auto1"/><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mr-stats.frenchbasketballscouting.fr/joueur/traore-nolan-8058|website=MR Stats|title=Toutes les saisons de joueur TRAORE Nolan|trans-title=All seasons of the player TRAORE Nolan|language=French}}</ref>

Traoré  received his ''[[baccalauréat]]'' in 2023, one year early.<ref name="auto"/> 
He's Ivorian descent through his father.

==Professional career==

===Centre Fédéral (2021–2024)===
Traoré was admitted to the training institute [[INSEP]] in 2021 and began playing for their affiliated team, [[Centre Fédéral de Basket-ball]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.saintcharlesbasket.fr/articles/71195-nolan-traore-et-talis-soulhac-integrent-le-pole-france|publisher={{ill|Saint-Charles Charenton|fr|Saint-Charles Charenton Saint-Maurice Basket-ball}}|date=2021|title=Nolan Traoré et Talis Soulhac intègrent le Pole France !|language=French|trans-title=Nolan Traoré and Talis Soulhac join Pole France!}}</ref> Playing in the French third tier, [[Nationale Masculine 1]], he averaged 2.2 points in 2021–22, 11.2 points in 2022–23, and then 16.8 points in 2023–24.<ref name="auto4"/> He was their leading player during the 2023–24 season and had a [[Player efficiency rating|rating]] of over 30 in several games; he was also named the team's player of the month multiple times.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ffbb.com/nm1/nolan-traore-lexplosion|publisher=[[French Federation of Basketball]]|title=Nolan Traoré, l'explosion|date=13 December 2023|trans-title=Nolan Traoré, the explosion|author=Guérineau, Julien|language=French|access-date=6 June 2024|archive-date=25 March 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240325172522/https://www.ffbb.com/nm1/nolan-traore-lexplosion|url-status=dead}}</ref> In the 2024 [[Euroleague Basketball Next Generation Tournament|Adidas Next Generation Tournament]] (ANGT) against [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet|Barcelona]], he scored a record 45 points while helping INSEP win in overtime.<ref name="auto3">{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/40254991/projected-2025-nba-lottery-pick-nolan-traore-staying-france|publisher=[[ESPN]]|title=Projected 2025 NBA lottery pick Nolan Traore staying in France|author=Givony, Jonathan|date=1 June 2024}}</ref> He won an award at the end of the season as the best young player in the league.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.bebasket.fr/aaron-levarity-couronne-mvp-de-nationale-1-nolan-traore-et-le-htv-a-lhonneur|website=BeBasket.fr|language=French|title=Aaron Levarity couronné MVP de Nationale 1, Nolan Traoré et le HTV à l'honneur|author=Lacoste, Alexandre|date=24 April 2024|trans-title=Aaron Levarity crowned MVP of Nationale 1, Nolan Traoré and HTV in the spotlight}}</ref>

===Saint-Quentin (2024–2025)===
Traoré was signed to [[Saint-Quentin Basket-Ball]] in the French top tier, [[LNB Élite]], at the end of March 2024, and later made his debut against [[AS Monaco Basket|AS Monaco]].<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.courrier-picard.fr/id508015/article/2024-03-28/basket-elite-nolan-traore-17-ans-rejoint-le-sqbb-comme-pigiste-medical-de|newspaper={{ill|Le Courrier picard|fr}}|title=Basket (Élite) : Nolan Traoré (17 ans) rejoint le SQBB comme pigiste médical|language=French|trans-title=Basketball (Elite): Nolan Traoré (17 years old) joins the SQBB as a medical freelancer.|date=28 March 2024|author=Jonneau, Eric; Sanson, Nicolas}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.lnb.fr/elite/joueur/?id=9984|publisher=[[LNB Élite]]|title=Nolan Traore |language=French}}</ref> Later in the season, he set the all-time league record for most points in a game by a player under 18, with 25.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.bebasket.fr/nolan-traore-premier-mineur-de-lhistoire-a-25-points-en-betclic-elite-il-progresse-match-apres-match|website=BeBasket.fr|language=French|title=Nolan Traoré, premier mineur de l'histoire à 25 points en Betclic ÉLITE : " Il progresse match après match "|author=Lacoste, Alexandre|date=8 May 2024|trans-title=Nolan Traoré, first minor in history to 25 points in Betclic ELITE: “He progresses match after match”}}</ref> He ended the season with seven games played and 10.3 points per game.<ref name="auto4"/>

Traoré was projected as a [[lottery pick]] in [[ESPN]]'s February 2024 mock [[2025 NBA draft]].<ref name="auto3"/> In April 2024, he participated in the [[Nike Hoop Summit]] all-star game, being one of the top performers with 18 points and four assists against top-ranked [[National Basketball Association|NBA]] prospects.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://sports.yahoo.com/cooper-flagg-aj-dybantsa-and-nolan-traore-among-standouts-at-nike-hoop-summit-143016682.html|website=[[Yahoo!]]|title=Cooper Flagg, AJ Dybantsa and Nolan Traore among standouts at Nike Hoop Summit|date=15 April 2024|author=Peek, Krysten}}</ref><ref>{{Cite magazine|url=https://www.si.com/nba/draft/newsfeed/draft-nolan-traore-nike-hoop-summit|magazine=[[Sports Illustrated]]|title=A Scout's Take: Assessing Nolan Traore's 2024 Nike Hoop Summit Performance|author=Hines, Jam|date=19 April 2024}}</ref> After the season 2023–24 season, Traoré had offers to play for a number of teams, including many top U.S. [[college basketball]] programs, but opted to stay in France, announcing his intention to sign a two-year contract with Saint-Quentin on 1 June 2024.<ref name="auto3"/> On 3 October, Traoré made his European debut and scored 27 points in a [[Basketball Champions League|Champions League]] home win against [[Kolossos Rodou B.C.|Kolossos Rhodes]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Manisa stun Murcia, 18-year-old Traore shines on big night for BCL debutants |url=https://www.championsleague.basketball/en/news/manisa-stun-murcia-18-year-old-traore-shines-on-big-night-for-bcl-debutants |access-date=4 October 2024 |website=www.championsleague.basketball |language=en}}</ref> It was the most points scored in a Champions League game by a player under age 21, beating the previous record of [[Alperen Şengün]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Morning After: The kids are alright |url=https://www.championsleague.basketball/en/news/morning-after-the-kinds-are-alright |access-date=4 October 2024 |website=www.championsleague.basketball |language=en}}</ref> On 10 May 2025, Traoré was named the [[Basketball Champions League Best Young Player]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Back-to-back MVP Huertas headlines Season 9 award winners |url=https://www.championsleague.basketball/en/news/back-to-back-mvp-huertas-headlines-season-9-award-winners |access-date=10 May 2025 |website=www.championsleague.basketball |language=en}}</ref>

===Brooklyn Nets (2025–present)===
On 25 June 2025, the [[Brooklyn Nets]] selected Traoré with the 19th overall pick in the [[2025 NBA draft]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Kaplan |first=Lucas |date=25 June 2025 |title=With #19 pick, Brooklyn Nets select Nolan Traore, French point guard |url=https://www.netsdaily.com/2025/6/25/24456089/with-19-pick-brooklyn-nets-select-nolan-traore-french-point-guard |access-date=26 June 2025 |website=NetsDaily |language=en}}</ref> On December 15, he was assigned to their G League affiliate, the [[Long Island Nets]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Nets' Nolan Traore: Assigned to G League |url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/nets-nolan-traore-assigned-to-g-league-508714/ |website=[[CBS Sports]] |access-date=December 18, 2025 |date=December 16, 2025}}</ref>

==National team career==
Traoré represented France at the [[2022 FIBA U16 European Championship]], averaging 13.6 points.<ref name="auto2">{{Cite web|url=https://www.fiba.basketball/fr/player/320259/Nolan--Traore|publisher=[[FIBA]]|title=Nolan Traore}}</ref> In 2023, he participated at the [[2023 FIBA U18 European Championship|FIBA U18 European Championship]] and averaged 8.6 points.<ref name="auto2"/>
